ThingDef.label: Oberonia Aurea Ranger Rifle
ThingDef.description: The semi-automatic rifle developed by the Oberonia Aurea Empire for Far Rangers before coming into contact with the Milky Way can only be applied for deployment by experienced Far Rangers who are preparing for a risky adventure. Its large caliber rifle bullets can effectively stop the movement of wild animals and ensure the safety of faraway travelers.

ThingDef.label: Oberonia Aurea Hunter Blade
ThingDef.description: A short knife with complex craftsmanship and extremely sharp edges that can easily cut open the skin, effectively deterring and damaging wild animals.

ThingDef.label: Technical Officer Self Defense Dagger
ThingDef.description: The experimental weapon of the Oberonia Aurea Empire, which has not yet been officially installed, has a self triggering EMP core embedded in its blade. When it hits an enemy, it will also cause an EMP strike. \n\nDue to the fact that the weapon is currently in the research and development stage and has not yet been put into mass production, most of it is temporarily assigned to technical officers in the Milky Way as a self-defense weapon.

ThingDef.label: Technical Officer's cane
ThingDef.description: The Oberonia Aurea Empire uniformly distributed canes to technical officials in the Milky Way, and made some self-defense modifications while ensuring aesthetics. It is equipped with an EMP pulse device, which can exert certain suppression ability when facing the mechanical body.

ThingDef.label: Technical Officer Self Defense SMG
ThingDef.description: The experimental weapon of the Oberonia Aurea Empire, which has not yet been officially equipped, is a specially designed EMP ammunition that can cause paralysis on mechanical objects upon hit. In addition, although the gun body is small, the destructive power cannot be underestimated due to the installation of an electromagnetic acceleration barrel. \n\nDue to the fact that the weapon is currently in the research and development stage and has not yet been put into mass production, most of it is temporarily assigned to technical officers in the Milky Way as a self-defense weapon.

ThingDef.label: Heavy Assault Rifle
ThingDef.description:
Heavy firearms with replaceable pressure chambers were adopted for greater destructive power. Compared to normal assault rifles, they may not be as agile, but their strength lies in their more fierce firepower, allowing them to perform exceptionally well against heavy enemies. 

For safety and firearm lifespan considerations, the pressurization chamber of this firearm is usually in a low load state and only activated when firing. 

Each shot will increase damage and armor penetration by 10%, reaching full capacity after a 50% increase.

ThingDef.label: Heavy assault SMG
ThingDef.description:
Heavy firearms with replaceable pressure chambers were adopted for greater destructive power. Compared to conventional submachine guns, they may not be as effective in pouring firepower at close range, but they are more aggressive in single point firepower and can perform wonders when facing heavy enemies. 

For safety and firearm lifespan considerations, the pressurization chamber of this firearm is usually in a low load state and only activated when firing. 

Each shot will increase damage and armor penetration by 10%, reaching full capacity after a 50% increase.

ThingDef.label: Recoilless Cannon for Assault Operations
ThingDef.description: The standard single soldier support weapon of the Oberonia Aurea Empire, made of lightweight material, almost does not burden the shooter with its gun body. Unlike anti heavy armor weapons, the grenades used in this individual artillery are more suitable for dealing damage to a large number of enemies, rather than focusing on a single heavy unit.

ThingDef.label: Oberonia Aurea Ranger Self Defense Shotgun
ThingDef.description:
The Oberonia Aurea Empire provided self-protection shotguns for distant travelers and palace personnel in areas where wild beasts frequently roamed. The loud noise during firing can effectively intimidate and deter wild beasts, and has considerable killing power at close range. 

When firing, this firearm will deal 0-15 projectile damage to the target based on distance, reaching its maximum damage within 5 squares. 

If the distance between the target and the user is within 5-23 squares, it will also cause a 0-2 projectile splash damage to all units within 1.5 squares around the target.

ThingDef.label: Technical Officer Self Defense Shotgun
ThingDef.description:
The experimental weapon of the Oberonia Aurea Empire, which has not yet been officially installed, is equipped with a trigger type micro EMP core in each projectile, which can play a significant role in both fighting against mechanical clans and normal close range combat. In addition, due to the experimental bore design, the concentration of the projectile can be ensured even at a longer distance. 

Due to the fact that the weapon is currently in the research and development stage and has not yet been put into mass production, most of it is temporarily assigned to technical officers in the Milky Way as a self-defense weapon. 

When firing, this firearm will deal 1-10 projectile damage to the target based on distance, reaching its maximum damage within 6 squares.

ThingDef.label: Oberonia Aurea medical staff cane
ThingDef.description: The standard medical cane used by the Traditional Chinese Medicine Department of the Jin Yuan Lan Palace. Its structure is highly in line with human mechanics, and the internal system can automatically assist based on pressure feedback, effectively improving the patient's mobility.

ThingDef.label: Oberonia Aurea Far Walker Hook and Rope Spear
ThingDef.description: The light exploration equipment carried by the far hikers of the Oberonia Aurea Lanta can shoot a high-strength fixed hook with a steel cable in a designated direction for easy climbing and crossing. In addition to regular hooks and ropes, far travelers often carry several harpoon spearheads to replace and protect themselves when needed.

ThingDef.label: Assault Anti Heavy Armor Support Rifle
ThingDef.description: One of the specialized anti mechanical weapons developed by the Oberonia Aurea Empire, possessing excellent medium range firepower. Although powerful in firepower, due to being too bulky and positioned vaguely, it did not receive standard equipment. Instead, a follow-up heavy weapon series and anti heavy armor rifles were developed based on this firearm.

ThingDef.label: Assault Anti Heavy Armor Battery Rifle
ThingDef.description: One of the specialized anti mechanical weapons developed by the Oberonia Aurea Empire. Due to a flaw in the design concept, although the weapon has astonishing lethality, its overly bulky body and extremely poor shooting experience make it difficult to call it a single soldier weapon, so the gun was not standardized for installation.

ThingDef.label: Assault combat firepower SMG
ThingDef.description: The product of the early military development of the Oberonia Aurea Empire, due to its overly one-sided emphasis on the suppressive effect of submachine guns, made it extremely difficult to control. Even if the flaw was later discovered and a new grip was installed, it failed to save its poor handling and ultimately was not installed.

ThingDef.label: Oberonia Aurea Industrial Welding Knife
ThingDef.description: A common repair tool in the industrial department of the Oberonia Aurea Empire, the extremely high temperature laser blade only needs to slightly scratch the welding area to complete the welding. \n\nTo prevent accidental injury, this tool has a frontal biological detection and a mechanism for pressing the blade, so using this weapon for attacks will require certain skills.

ThingDef.label: Oberonia Aurea oscillation cleaning box
ThingDef.description: A cleaning tool in the Oberonia Aurea Palace that uses low-frequency micro oscillation to make sticky dust easier to clean. If someone intentionally modifies it, the extremely high frequency and huge vibrations will cause great damage to the internal organs of the organism and cause dizziness. \nNevertheless, fighting with this cumbersome thing would not be a wise move.

ThingDef.label: Heavy duty sweeping shotgun
ThingDef.description:
The Golden Iris Empire has developed a special shotgun specifically for raiding teams in high-intensity areas, equipped with an instant pressure chamber specifically designed for urban warfare. It has destructive output capabilities at close range and plays an irreplaceable role in both indoor raiding and urban warfare annihilation.
Unfortunately, the instantaneous pressurization causes the weapon to lose accuracy at medium distances, making it a significant disadvantage in mid to long range combat.

\-When fired, this firearm will deal damage to the target by 1-12 projectiles based on distance, with the highest damage occurring within 5 grids.

If the distance between the target and the user is within 5-14 grids, it will also cause 1-3 projectile splash damage to all units within 1.5 grids around the target.
